svg.title: My run of the ready-made agent, one lap of the cycle. The human asks how much the steak dishes are. The AI makes one tool call, search_menu with "steak dishes and prices". The tool returns two entries: Signature Steak at 35,000 won and Tenderloin Steak Salad at 26,000 won. The AI answers with both prices.
